description: If \(M\) satisfies the infinitary successor sentence, there is an isomorphism \(e:\mathbb N\to M\) in the shared zero-and-successor language, and this same map satisfies \(e(n)=(S^n(0))^M\) for every \(n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.successor_canonical_isomorphism.{w} (M : Type w)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.successorLanguage.Structure M]
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.successorSentence.Realize M) :
  ∃ e, ∀ (n : ℕ), e n = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.numeralValue M n
